_comment: Optional. Delete this file and everything still works with defaults.
'disabled' lists plugin names (the filename without .js) to skip at boot.
'config' is handed to each plugin as plugin.config.
'urls' lists https URLs fetched into memory at every boot.
The same three are settable from the environment, which is the only way
on a host where this file cannot be edited:
_why_healthz_is_disabled: healthz opens a port, and a Discord bot has no reason to serve one. It
exists for platforms that classify the deployment as a web service and
restart it when nothing listens on the port they inject.
Turn it on there with PLUGINS_ALLOW=healthz, or by emptying the list
below. Your own plugins are unaffected - anything not named here loads.
